name: Cyberdelia
summary: The psychedelic side of early cyberculture. It joins cyberpunk with acid colour: fractals, kaleidoscopes, posterised Photoshop collage, early 3D type and rave flyers. It takes its name from the club in the film Hackers (1995).

philosophy.core_thesis: The computer is a consciousness machine: use acid colour, fractal repetition and raw early software effects to show a mind that has gone into the network.
design_principles: Fill the ground with a fractal or kaleidoscope tile that repeats 6 or 8 times around a centre, at 40% to 60% opacity.
Set a palette of 4 acid hues (#FF2BD6, #19F0FF, #B6FF1A, #FF8A00) on a deep violet ground (#12002B).
Use gradients with hard bands: posterise to 5 to 7 steps, and never blend smoothly.
Set display type in extended, outlined or 3D-extruded letters at 72px or larger, with a 4px offset copy in a second hue.
Collage cut-out photographs with a 2px white keyline and a posterised colour wash at 60% opacity.
Rotate accent elements by 3° to 12° and overlap layers by 16px to 48px.
Keep body text on a solid dark block of 90% opacity at 16px with contrast of 7:1 or more.
anti_patterns: Strict symmetric grids with wide margins
Calm, minimal pages with one image

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose 12-column grid that layers break on purpose; blocks of text sit on dark panels over a full-bleed pattern.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero with a radial focus; text blocks rotate by 3° to 12°; elements overlap by 16px to 48px.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 0px radius and a 3px border in a neon hue; circles and starbursts for accents; a 4px offset shadow in a second hue.

font_pairings.note: A wide, rounded techno display face with a clear text face.
A multi-line display face for flyer headlines with a mono text face.
A shaded, 3D-looking face that echoes early extruded type.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 700 for text and 400 for display.
Set display in a wide face, and mix 2 sizes in one headline.
Put each key word in a second acid hue.

color.palette_structure: Four acid hues on a deep violet ground, with white as the one neutral.
color.contrast_rules: Text on deep violet holds 12:1 or more; neon hues carry headlines, borders and shapes, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Posterised gradients in 5 to 7 hard bands; fractal and kaleidoscope tiles; a noise grain of 6%.
color.light_and_shadow: Hard offset shadows of 4px in a second hue; a glow of 8px to 16px on neon type; no soft cast shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Screen-born: raster filters, posterised layers, printed flyer stock with halftone grain.
materiality.border_rules: A 3px solid border in a neon hue on panels; a 2px white keyline on cut-outs.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No backdrop blur; hard 4px offset shadows; glow of 8px to 16px on type.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Bold solid glyphs at 24px with a thick 3px edge; eyes, spirals, circuit lines and lightning.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Fractals, kaleidoscopes, wireframe heads, chrome and early 3D renders, posterised collage of faces and circuit boards.

motion.transition_physics: Looping and hypnotic: kaleidoscopes rotate 360° in 30s; colour bands cycle at 6s; headlines jump in with a 4px glitch shift for 120ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shifts the hue by 60° and the offset shadow by 4px; active inverts the panel colours.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a dizzy, joyful rush: the network is alive and the mind is in it.

use_cases: club, festival and music event pages
avoid_when: The audience is conservative, medical or financial.
The page needs fast reading of dense content.
The product needs a quiet, neutral tone.

modifiers.how: Reduce the palette to pink, cyan and violet; replace fractals with a grid floor and one statue; keep the glow.
Replace the posterised digital effects with hand-drawn lettering and warm poster colour; keep the repeated patterns.
Switch to silver and baby blue on a light ground with pill shapes; keep one chrome headline.

pack.why: Heavy solid forms with a thick edge match the loud shapes of a rave flyer.
